brief: Indian shares are volatile: Sensex crashed over 1,300 points from the day's high and metal and bank stocks fell, even as Nifty has held up better than global peers. US futures rebounded nearly 2% after last week's tech rout, but Kospi and other Asian markets stayed weak.
themes: Intraday sell-off in metals and banks
Order-win rally in rail and infra
